description: This file defines a Python class LangfuseOtelLogger that extends OpenTelemetry to facilitate Langfuse-specific observability and tracing. It includes methods for setting span attributes, extracting metadata, configuring environment variables, and constructing dynamic headers for Langfuse OTEL integration.

classes.name: LangfuseOtelLogger
classes.description: A custom OpenTelemetry logger for Langfuse observability, providing methods to set span attributes, extract metadata, configure environment variables, and generate dynamic headers for Langfuse OTEL integration.

methods.name: set_langfuse_otel_attributes
methods.description: Sets Langfuse-specific attributes on an OpenTelemetry span, including general and custom metadata.

methods.name: _extract_langfuse_metadata
methods.description: Extracts and enriches Langfuse metadata from provided kwargs, including header-based metadata.

methods.name: _set_metadata_attributes
methods.description: Sets individual metadata attributes on a span, serializing complex types as JSON.

methods.name: _set_observation_output
methods.description: Sets output-related attributes on a span based on response object content, including tool calls and message content.

methods.name: _set_langfuse_specific_attributes
methods.description: Sets Langfuse-specific environment and metadata attributes onto a span.

methods.name: _get_langfuse_otel_host
methods.description: Retrieves the Langfuse OTEL host URL from environment variables.

methods.name: get_langfuse_otel_config
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Langfuse OTEL configuration, setting environment variables for endpoint and headers based on environment variables and keys.

methods.name: _get_langfuse_authorization_header
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded Basic authorization header from public and secret keys.

methods.name: construct_dynamic_otel_headers
methods.description: Creates dynamic headers for Langfuse based on provided callback parameters, mainly for team/key based logging.
